evidence_items.publisher: Stanford Center for Research on Foundation Models
evidence_items.explanation: The assessment identifies a disclosure gap that prevents a reliable comparison of GPT-4's corpus with competitors. Nondisclosure establishes uncertainty, not different or identical data.
Meta describes changing data and curation practices. This cautions against inferring identical training inputs from common reliance on web data, but does not quantify cross-company differences.

The study supports concern about a future public human-text bottleneck under its growth assumptions. It neither measures identical company corpora nor establishes that shared data causes converging outputs.

unresolved_gaps: No sufficiently complete corpus comparison across all five firms was located.
No matched longitudinal output study isolated shared data as the cause of convergence.
The supply study concerns public human text under assumptions, not exhaustion of every useful data source.
